name: DeleteSpeech

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify an instance ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The IDs of the corpus entries to delete. You can obtain corpus IDs from the **Corpus Configuration** console or by invoking [CreateSpeech](~~217571~~). Upon a successful invocation, the **Data** field in the response contains the corpus ID.

N is an integer in the range of 1 to 20, indicating that you can delete up to 20 corpus entries per request.
parameters.description_zh:
需要删除的语料ID，您可以在**语料配置**控制台获取语料ID，或者调用[CreateSpeech](~~217571~~)，成功后返回的**Data**字段为语料ID。

N为整数，取值范围：1~20，表示每次最多删除20条。
